title: command-event
description: One instruction to change the music. Buttons, voice, gestures and email all produce this same event, and the command system applies it. 'command' is a control id from control-catalog.json.

value.description: New value (set/follow), or the step (nudge). Omit for trigger and toggle.

mapping.description: Name of the mapping rule that fired, if any.

signal.description: Id of the signal that caused it, if any.
